notable_absence.finding: The Purpose section documents a specific error mode - 'You cannot use the EXECUTE FUNCTION statement to execute a built-in SQL++ function. If you do this, error 10101: Function not found is generated' - but no predicate in the registry currently models 'raises error code X under condition Y' for the query engine (the closest analog, dependsOnService, was used elsewhere for SDK-side error-code-to-statement mapping, not for this kind of engine-side validation error). Flagged rather than force-fit.

cross_product_finding: Identical credential-type/function-scope privilege shape to dropfunction.json (Global Function Execute vs Query Execute), confirming the two-dimensional model (credential type x object scope) is a stable, repeated pattern across the UDF DDL/DML family, not a one-off.
